title: 2 Hours Downtown Austin Segway Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the natural beauty of Austin on this thrilling Segway adventure. Glide through historic downtown while soaking in the sights and sounds of the city. This guided tour not only offers a unique way to experience the city but also provides insights into its history and fun facts that will enhance your adventure. Perfect for thrill-seekers and outdoor enthusiasts, this tour lets you enjoy Austin's landscapes in an exciting way.

- Guided tour showcasing Austin's beautiful historic landmarks
including the Sate Capitol.
- Experience unique outdoor scenery while riding a Segway
- Perfect for adventure lovers and those seeking a fun experience
- Learn about the history and culture of Austin from expert guides
this tour is about 4 miles of riding and lasts up to 2 hours.
